rules.message: In apps/factory, import via the `@/` alias instead of relative paths.
rules.source: AGENTS.md: In `apps/factory`, import via the `@/` alias, not relative paths.

rules.message: Never edit or delete applied migrations; change schema.ts and run `pnpm db:generate` to add a new migration instead.
Schema changes must be accompanied by the generated SQL migration in packages/core/migrations/ (run `pnpm db:generate`).
rules.source: AGENTS.md: Schema changes: edit schema.ts, run `pnpm db:generate`, commit the generated SQL in `packages/core/migrations/`.

rules.message: New/changed repo functions need a Vitest case in repo.test.ts.
rules.source: AGENTS.md: Add a Vitest case in `repo.test.ts` for new repo functions.

rules.message: Pages must not build queries inline; add a function in packages/core/src/repo.ts instead.
rules.source: AGENTS.md: All data access goes through functions in `packages/core/src/repo.ts`; pages don't build queries inline.

rules.message: Projects are self-contained and must not import from apps/ or packages/.
rules.source: AGENTS.md: `projects/*` ... must not import from `apps/` or `packages/`.

rules.message: Do not add minimumReleaseAgeExclude entries to pull brand-new package versions.

rules.source: AGENTS.md: Never commit `.env` files or `*.db` files.
AGENTS.md: Never commit `.env` files or `*.db` files.
